initialExam.title: Army Agniveer Clerk/Store Keeper 2026
initialExam.description: Agniveer Clerk/Store Keeper Technical entry in the Indian Army for administrative and logistics roles. Involves clerical duties, store management, and account keeping.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass with 60% aggregate and 50% in each subject
initialExam.qualifications: 10+2 from recognized board with minimum 60% aggregate
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge, General Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, English, Accounts/Book Keeping.
initialExam.examPattern: CEE: 50 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes. Also includes typing test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Registration → Rally (Physical/Medical) → CEE Written Exam → Typing Test → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Agniveer Clerk/Store Keeper in Indian Army units
initialExam.careerGrowth: Agniveer → 25% retained → Lance Naik → Naik → Havildar → Naib Subedar → Subedar.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Attend rally 5. CEE exam
initialExam.perks: Seva Nidhi: ₹11.71 lakh, Risk/Hardship allowance, Medical, Canteen, Free rations
